Amen Thompson at the buzzer. He's upset there's no call and popped up hot. Rockets lead 62-46 at halftime. Their first-quarter run still the difference.

Houston is 11/22 from deep. Pacers 5/17. T.J. McConnell and Pascal Siakam comfortably the best Pacers that half.

items.title: It's pretty amazing for Houston that an opponent works for a switch to get Amen Thompson off them, and they end up with Tari Eason. Then, they work for another switch and they end up with Marcus Smart.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
It's pretty amazing for Houston that an opponent works for a switch to get Amen Thompson off them, and they end up with Tari Eason. Then, they work for another switch and they end up with Marcus Smart.

Houston is a really well-built team.
